subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the
stimulus: sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) Now a new thinking took hold of the farmer. (b) He could not think where to keep the money. (c) He said to him, "Look, my friend, I have brought one thousand rupees for you." (d) He took the bag of money from the rich man and thanked him. (e) "Keep this money and remove your distress." (f) He said to himself, "One thousand rupees is a lot of money." (g) The rich man went to the farmer with one thousand rupees in a bag. (h) The farmer was surprised. Part−B : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 g c e h d a f b The rich man went to the farmer with one thousand rupees in a bag. He said to him, "Look, my friend, I have brought one thousand rupees for you." "Keep this money and remove your distress." The farmer was surprised. He took the bag of money from the rich man and thanked him. Now a new thinking took hold of the farmer. He said to himself, "One thousand rupees is a lot of money." He could not think where to keep the money. Part−B : Writing Test See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 222
